offering_description.value: SS&C sells investment software and outsourced fund and investment operations to asset managers, wealth managers, banks and other financial institutions. It also provides virtual data rooms for deal teams, process automation software for enterprises, and claims and benefits administration technology and services for health plans.

primary_products.value: investment and portfolio accounting software; trading and risk management software; virtual data rooms; robotic process automation software; health plan and pharmacy claims software

primary_services.value: fund administration and transfer agency; outsourced investment operations; fund distribution; investment management; health benefits administration and claims processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Asset and wealth managers, banks, insurers, deal advisers, corporate teams and health plans; B2G: Public pension funds and government agencies using investment operations or automation tools; B2C: Individual investors in company-managed exchange-traded funds

end_markets.value: asset and wealth management; banking and insurance; corporate transactions; healthcare benefits; enterprise process automation

revenue_model.value: service fees: Fund administration, transfer agency, outsourced investment operations and health benefits administration; subscription: Hosted investment applications, virtual data rooms and process automation software; licensing or royalties: Licenses for installed investment and enterprise software; transaction or usage fees: Processing fund transactions and healthcare claims; commissions or management fees: Managing investment funds
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties; transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes fund, portfolio and claims data for financial institutions and health plans; software / platform: Develops and hosts applications for investment firms, deal teams, enterprises and health plans; financial intermediary: Manages pooled investment funds and provides distribution services to fund sponsors
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: diversified: Investment software and administration, deal data rooms, enterprise automation, and health benefits technology and administration

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving financial institutions, corporate deal teams and health plans; partners / resellers: Technology resellers and systems integrators for enterprise automation

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC registration for transfer agency and investment advisory subsidiaries, FINRA oversight for broker-dealers, and HIPAA rules for health data
